_readme: The book's 'List of common suggestions for what to do with a paperclip' (the answer page, page 235), 25 items, read from the printed page on 2026-11-07. Used by the Far Out game: an idea on the list moves you one space, an idea not on it moves you two. Mark reviews.
common: Push the reset button on electronic gadgets.
Linking them together to make a necklace or bracelet.
Hang cards from a chain of them.
Use to clean fingernails and toenails.
Magnetise them together to make sculptures.
Clean up the grout between bathroom tiles.
For making cheese and pineapple sticks.
Hang decorations or Christmas ornaments from them.
Make fake specs for stuffed animals.
